name: Sample Pad
description: Made to try this out. A tiny test curve of 0.003 ZRO, and trading stops when it fills.

launch.function: function createToken(string name_, string symbol_, string metadata_) payable returns (address token)

buy.function: function purchase(address token, uint256 minTokens) payable returns (uint256)

sell.function: function dump(address token, uint256 amount, uint256 minZro) returns (uint256 received)

quoteBuy.function: function previewPurchase(address token, uint256 zroIn) view returns (uint256 tokens)

quoteSell.function: function previewDump(address token, uint256 amount) view returns (uint256)

created.event: event TokenBorn(address indexed token, address indexed dev, string name, string symbol, string metadata)
created.creator: dev

buy.event: event Purchased(address indexed token, address indexed buyer, uint256 paid, uint256 got, uint256 raised)

sell.event: event Dumped(address indexed token, address indexed seller, uint256 amount, uint256 received, uint256 raised)

graduated.event: event Completed(address indexed token, uint256 raised)
